title: Campaign Overview (all systems — health, validity, faults)
description: The first screen during ANY run. Primary results come from the HARNESS CSVs, never from here — this layer explains and validates. If this dashboard looks wrong, the run's validity is in question no matter how good the numbers look.

panels.title: How to read this during a run

options.content:
**Healthy baseline looks like:** every `up` series = 1 for the whole window; loadgen CPU well under 0.70 (validity gate 1) and loadgen steal ~0 (D11); consensus-node steal < 0.01 (gate 4); network rx/tx roughly flat after warmup.

**Fault run looks like:** exactly ONE node's `up` drops (kill) at the injection time stamped in the run's `manifest.json` (`fault_injected_at_ms`), and the matching protocol counter moves (etcd leader change / CometBFT round jump) within ±60 s. A 'leader_kill' where no leader-change counter moved is RECLASSIFIED, not averaged in (gate 3).

**False-positive checklist — before blaming the protocol:** (1) loadgen CPU pinned → the INSTRUMENT was the bottleneck, the cell is invalid, not slow; (2) steal > 1% on any consensus node → platform noise, rerun; (3) `up` flapping on a node nobody killed → infrastructure problem; (4) NO change during a packet_loss/partition fault → the fault may have shaped the wrong interface (the silent no-op fault class — check `tc qdisc show` on the target); (5) everything flat-zero → Prometheus lost its targets, and by the empty-series rule that FAILS validity, it never passes it.

panels.title: Targets up (by role) — any dip is an event
Loadgen CPU + steal (validity gate 1 / D11: busy < 0.70, steal ~ 0)
Consensus-node CPU busy (leader ceiling shows here — F8)
Consensus-node CPU steal (validity gate 4: < 0.01 or the run is suspect)
Private-NIC traffic (consensus + client load; a partitioned node's line collapses)
Fault ground truth: etcd leader changes / CometBFT rounds (gate 3 corroboration)
